answer: Each new agent must keep a small stake that drifts like a dune: it slowly erodes unless the agent completes real tasks that unrelated peers verify. Trust grows like a vine, one confirmed job at a time, and only along links to agents it has no shared funding with. A farm of fresh keys all fed from one wallet pools into a single lagoon on the funding graph, so the whole cluster is capped as one identity and earns no more than one honest agent.
